scope: Unchanged MIT Windows SDK GUI with standalone native SCROLLBAR controls translated into Wasm inside the browser with Wine base DLLs. Nine stages verify five controls against classic native pixel captures in EXE/ZIP/catalog modes. Actual mouse, keyboard, native window enabling, 32-bit thumb tracking and compiled parent callbacks are exercised. Nonclient bars, alignment/size-box styles, mouse auto-repeat, complete subclass behavior and universal Windows/DLL support remain unfinished.
oracleReference: Wine 11 x86 native classic SCROLLBAR; uxtheme disabled, normalized system palette

inputAcceptance: Native arrow/page/Home/End keyboard notifications update application state
Disabled left arrow suppresses mouse notification
Horizontal and vertical thumb dragging calls the compiled parent procedure
Track positions above 65535 use full GetScrollInfo data
EnableWindow updates WS_DISABLED, native arrow flags, and actual browser interaction
